stories.title: HTTP QUERY Method: The Grey Zone Between GET And POST., (Fri, Sep 18th)
stories.description: In June 2026 the IETF published RFC 10008[1], defining a new HTTP method: "QUERY". The HTTP protocol faced already by changes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3) but it's the first new standard HTTP verb since "PATCH" in 2010!

stories.title: Click2Shell WordPress Flaw Lets Attackers Gain RCE With a Single Malicious Link
stories.description: WordPress administrators are being urged to update after researchers disclosed Click2Shell, an exploit chain that can turn one malicious link into remote code execution (RCE) on a vulnerable website.

stories.title: BragJack Attack Lets Malicious Extensions Hijack AI Agents Across 5 Major Browsers
stories.description: Security researchers have disclosed BragJack, a new attack technique that allows a malicious browser extension to seize trusted communication channels used by AI assistants in Chrome, Edge, Opera Neon, Comet, and Claude in Chrome.

stories.title: Public Exploits Released for Four Linux Kernel Flaws That Enable Local Root
stories.description: Public exploits for four patched Linux kernel flaws let local users gain root; three require unprivileged user namespaces.

stories.title: New WordPress Click2Shell Flaw Forces Theme Installs, Can Chain to Code Execution
stories.description: WordPress 7.1.1 fixes Click2Shell, which can force theme installs from crafted links and was chained with a theme flaw for code execution.
